entries.name: chassis-01
entries.prompt: GAME-READY ISOLATED CASTLE CHASSIS ASSET, matching attached approved Castle Survivor reference EXACT design language, NOT another UI mockup. Output ONE front-facing stage1 timber castle chassis on true transparent background, same wide silhouette as reference. Keep golden metal brackets, purple roof and crown banner on UPPER LEFT keep, thick golden-brown carved timber supports, beautiful realistic pixelart highlights and floor shadows. Crucial silhouette: upper-left keep occupies ONLY LEFT 35 percent of total width; WIDE OPEN BATTLE DECK extends from x35% to x96%, at least60% total width, large visible top surface for hero versus enemy. Total chassis shape is landscape-ish castle keep above a broad rectangular room body, about width1024 height1280. Under deck: coherent carved ceiling rafters with hanging lantern, thick outer columns, exactly FIVE INDEPENDENT EMPTY ROOM APERTURES: three equal upper apertures, two wider lower apertures, matching reference3-above2-below layout. Aperture inner union width about78% overallwidth, height about42% overallheight; all FIVE windows have fully TRANSPARENT interiors, no room backgrounds/furniture, no plaques or text. Common beams and pillars remain visible around windows. Beneath rooms: handsome timber machinery/control bay with two recessed gear alcoves and reinforced lower chassis, matching reference. NO wheels (separately animated), NO cannon/turret, NO people/characters/enemy, NO UI, NO slot machine, NO buttons/menus/hearts, no numbers, NO background scenery/sky/ground. This is a usable layered sprite asset with five alpha holes, not a full screenshot. Reproduce reference's architecture, color, bevels, metal gold corner cuffs and struts faithfully; no simplification, no flat rectangle placeholders. Use rich crisp2.5D pixelart like reference. Entire chassis inside canvas, no clipping. Transparent exterior AND all five room interiors.
